steps.text: Roughly mash the beans with the cumin.
Mix the cheddar, mozzarella, corn, jalapeños and spring onions.
Spread the beans over four tortillas, top with the cheese mix and coriander and lid with the other four.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 16 rounds from the pastry, score a smaller circle in the middle of each without cutting through and brush with the egg.
Bake until risen and golden.

Cook the shallots and garlic in the butter until soft.

Fry the tofu in the oil until golden on both sides, then dice.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, honey, garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Dice the peeled eggs.
Spread the lettuce on a platter, lay rows of tofu, chickpeas, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese across it, scatter with chives and dress at the table.

s.note: Crisp tortillas filled with cheddar, mozzarella, black beans, corn and jalapeños, with sour cream
s.how: Roughly mash a drained 400g tin of black beans with 1 tsp ground cumin. Mix 150g grated cheddar and 150g grated mozzarella with 1 cup corn kernels, 3 tbsp chopped pickled jalapeños and 3 sliced spring onions. Spread the beans over 4 of 8 flour tortillas, top with the cheese mix and half a cup of coriander, and lid with the rest. Cook one at a time in a little of 1 tbsp butter over medium heat, pressing down, for 2 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with 200g sour cream.

s.note: Puff pastry cases filled with creamy garlic, thyme and parmesan mushrooms
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 16 rounds of 6cm from 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry, score a 4cm circle in the middle of each without cutting through, brush with beaten egg and bake for 15 minutes until risen. Press the centres down to make cases. Cook 2 diced shallots and 2 crushed garlic cloves in 30g butter for 4 minutes, add 300g finely chopped button mushrooms and 1 tsp thyme leaves and cook until dry. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, then 150ml thickened cream, simmer until thick and finish with 30g grated parmesan, salt and pepper. Fill the cases, scatter with chives and serve hot.

m.note: Chopped cos with poached chicken, crisp bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese in rows, with red wine vinaigrette
m.how: Put 2 chicken breasts in a pan of cold salted water, bring to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes, then turn off the heat, cover and leave for 20 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 9 minutes and cool in cold water. Fry 6 bacon rashers until crisp and chop. Whisk 3 tbsp red wine vinegar with 1 tsp dijon mustard, 1 tsp honey, 1 crushed garlic clove, 90ml olive oil, salt and pepper. Dice the chicken and eggs. Chop 2 baby cos lettuces onto a big platter and lay rows of chicken, bacon, egg, 2 diced avocados, 250g halved cherry tomatoes and 100g crumbled blue cheese across the top. Scatter with chives and dress at the table.

w.n: Stab 3 fake blood red velvet cupcakes
w.note: Red velvet cupcakes with cream cheese frosting and a raspberry coulis drip
w.how: Heat the oven to 175C and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Whisk 190g plain flour, 1 tbsp cocoa, 0.5 tsp bicarb soda and a pinch of salt. In another bowl whisk 150g caster sugar, 125ml vegetable oil, 1 egg, 125ml buttermilk, 1 tbsp red food colouring, 1 tsp vanilla and 1 tsp white vinegar, then fold in the dry mix. Fill the cases two-thirds full and bake for 20 minutes. Cool completely. Simmer 125g frozen raspberries with 2 tbsp caster sugar for 5 minutes, push through a sieve and cool. Beat 125g cream cheese, 50g butter and 200g icing sugar until smooth, pipe on the cupcakes and drizzle the coulis down the sides.

d.note: Vodka, orange liqueur and fresh lemon shaken ice cold in a sugar-rimmed glass with a lemon twist
d.how: Stir 50g caster sugar into 50ml hot water until dissolved and cool. Run a lemon wedge round the rims of 4 chilled glasses and dip them in 2 tbsp caster sugar. Shake 180ml vodka, 60ml orange liqueur, the juice of 3 lemons and the syrup hard with ice, in two batches. Strain into the glasses and finish with a lemon twist.
